data.name: Global Performance Management System & Head Talent Management
data.note_for_candidates: This role leads, designs and drive global Performance and Talent Management frameworks, aligning leadership goals, KPIs, and succession pipelines with business strategy. It focuses on building a data-driven, high-performance culture while strengthening leadership capability and overall organizational effectiveness.
data.job_description_text:
This role will be responsible to drive Performance and Talent Management frameworks across global, multi-geography operations. The role will translate business strategy into robust goal architecture, KRA/KPI design, leadership development, and succession planning frameworks that build a high-performance culture. Partnering closely with senior leadership, the incumbent will ensure talent strategies directly enable business growth, leadership capability, and sustained organizational effectiveness.

Responsibilities

Performance Management

  • Deep expertise in designing and driving performance management framework for senior leadership across India and global countries and regions, ensuring standardization while enabling local business relevance.
  • Experience in aligning performance metrics with organizational strategy and growth priorities.
  • Drive disciplined strategy & execution of leadership performance management, ensuring leader goals, reviews, differentiation, and feedback are tightly aligned to enterprise priorities and organizational goals.
  • Partner closely with the Group CHRO to integrate leadership performance outcomes with incentives, compensation decisions, and long-term leadership development strategies.
  • Enable objective, data-driven, and comparable performance assessments for Leaders across geographies, supported by robust analytics and governance mechanisms.
  • Embed a high-performance leadership culture focused on accountability, measurable outcomes, and values-based leadership behavior across the organization.

Talent Management

  • Develop and drive an integrated Talent Management framework aligned to business growth and strategic priorities.
  • Lead enterprise-wide talent reviews to identify high-potential, high-performing, and future-ready leaders.
  • Build structured talent segmentation and differentiation models to strengthen leadership effectiveness.
  • Partner with business leaders to anticipate capability needs and build future talent pipelines. • Establish frameworks for leadership capability assessment, development planning, and progression.
  • Use performance insights and talent data to guide promotion, mobility, and retention decisions.
  • Strengthen organizational capability through structured workforce and leadership planning.

Goal Setting, KRAs & KPIs

  • Design and drive the goal-setting and cascading processes, defining KRAs and KPIs for leadership and critical roles, and ensuring consistent adoption across the organization.
  • Translate business strategy and productivity priorities into clear, measurable individual and leadership goals, ensuring direct linkage to business outcomes.
  • Build and operate transparent, objective, and data-driven performance measurement mechanisms, enabling rigorous performance reviews, accountability, and timely course correction

Succession Planning & Future Talent Pipeline

  • Lead the succession planning for senior leadership and mission-critical roles, ensuring depth, readiness, and leadership continuity.
  • Drive structured talent and succession reviews to identify high-potential and future- ready leaders aligned to business priorities.
  • Establish clear succession governance, readiness metrics, and risk indicators to enable informed CXO and Group CHRO decisions.
  • Integrate succession outcomes with performance results, KRAs, and KPIs to strengthen leadership accountability and readiness. Translate succession insights into assessment- led development and progression plans.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to the Group CHRO and senior leaders on bench strength and succession risk.

Qualification & Experience

  • MBA / Postgraduate degree in Human Resources from a premier or reputed institute.
  • 18+ years of HR experience, with significant hands-on exposure to Performance Management, Talent Management, Succession Planning & creating future Talent Pipeline at a senior leadership level.
  • Global experience in designing, implementing, and governing performance management frameworks for senior leadership and critical roles.
  • Strong expertise in goal setting, KRAs, KPIs, and performance differentiation with clear linkage to business outcomes and productivity.
  • Industry Preference - Candidates from Consumer Durables, FMCG, or Big 4 Consulting firms preferred.

Core Leadership Competence

  • Strategic Thinking & Execution – Translates enterprise strategy into scalable frameworks with disciplined delivery and measurable impact.
  • Executive & Board Influence – Engages CXO and Board stakeholders with confidence, credibility, and data- backed insights.
  • Business & Commercial Acumen – Aligns performance and talent decisions with business outcomes and growth priorities.
  • Trusted Leadership Advisor – Acts as an objective, credible advisor on performance, succession, and leadership effectiveness.
  • Performance Insight & Governance – Interprets performance trends to guide leadership actions and strengthen organizational effectiveness.

data.name: Head - Institutional / Hospital Business
data.note_for_candidates: The role will lead the Hospital Division for a growing pharmaceutical business across private hospitals in India. The mandate is to drive business growth across large, medium, and standalone hospitals, with full ownership of P&L, portfolio expansion, institutional partnerships, and team leadership.
data.job_description_text:
About the Company
A well-established Indian pharmaceutical organization with a strong presence in multiple therapies and institutional business, focused on expanding its footprint across private hospital networks in India.

The Opportunity

The role will lead the Hospital Division for a growing pharmaceutical business across private hospitals in India. The mandate is to drive business growth across large, medium, and standalone hospitals, with full ownership of P&L, portfolio expansion, institutional partnerships, and team leadership. The position will play a critical role in strengthening hospital access, expanding chronic therapy presence, and building future-ready commercial capabilities including digital adoption, analytics-driven planning, and structured account management.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end hospital business performance including revenue, profitability, market share, and growth.
  • Develop annual operating plans, forecasting, and budgets aligned to business objectives.
  • Track regional performance and refine strategy based on market dynamics and competition.
  • Drive expansion across metro, Tier-1, Tier-2 and Tier-3 hospital markets
  • Lead institutional business across corporate hospital chains, trust hospitals, and standalone institutions.
  • Build strong relationships with hospital administrators, procurement heads, specialists, and key opinion leaders.
  • Ensure formulary inclusion, rate contracts, empanelment and long-term partnerships with hospital networks
  • Drive in-hospital execution, brand availability, and compliance to promotional guidelines.
  • Lead launch execution for new products within the hospital channel.
  • Lead and develop multi-layered teams including frontline managers, regional managers, and sales leaders.
  • Build capabilities in institutional selling, account management, scientific engagement, and digital promotion.
  • Establish performance-driven culture through structured reviews, coaching, and succession planning.
  • Collaborate closely with marketing, finance, supply chain, and digital teams for execution excellence.
  • Drive adoption of CRM, analytics, dashboards, and digital engagement tools.
  • Oversee all in-hospital activities including HCP engagement, product education, and supply coordination

Candidate Profile

  • Graduate in Science or Pharmacy; MBA / PGDM preferred.
  • 15+ years of experience in pharmaceutical / healthcare sales with strong exposure to institutional or hospital business.
  • Proven track record of managing large turnover businesses (~₹50 Cr or above) with multi-layer teams
  • Strong leadership, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills
Location: Mumbai

data.name: Business Head
data.note_for_candidates: Head a large-format retail platform, owning operations, inventory, and strategic growth while leading teams and driving expansion across premium and luxury segments.
data.job_description_text:
Brief About the Role

Our client is a well-established, family-promoted retail organisation with a strong presence in premium consumer retail. With over two decades of industry experience, the company has built a robust footprint across multiple regions, including Western and Northern India.

Headquartered in Gujarat, the organisation operates 60+ retail touchpoints across key cities such as Surat, Ahmedabad, Vadodara, Rajkot, Pune, Mumbai, and parts of North India. Backed by external investors, the business is now transitioning into a broader luxury retail platform, with plans to expand into curated premium and luxury segments.

The organisation is looking to hire a Business Head / CEO to lead and scale its flagship retail vertical over the next 3–5 years. This role will have end-to-end ownership of multi-region retail operations, driving growth, operational excellence, and expansion across 60+ stores, with a clear roadmap to scale significantly in the near term.

Responsibilities

- Own the P&L for the entire retail business across multiple regions

- Lead regional heads, clusters, and store operations across 60+ locations

- Drive inventory planning, procurement, and supply coordination

- Ensure seamless retail operations including hiring, retention, and performance management

- Act as the face of the organisation for key brand and partner relationships

- Ensure adherence to global retail standards, brand guidelines, and operational excellence

- Lead performance reviews with key stakeholders, including investors

- Drive aggressive store expansion (organic and inorganic), scaling from 60 to 200 stores

- Evaluate retail real estate, catchments, and premium store formats

- Support acquisitions, partnerships, and strategic growth initiatives

- Deliver 30–40% year-on-year growth and strengthen market leadership position

- Build strong on-ground connect with store teams across regions

- Lead large, high-energy teams in a fast-paced retail environment

- Drive culture, accountability, and performance across the organisation

Qualifications

- 20+ years of experience; ideal age bracket: 45–50

- Strong background in premium or large-format retail

- Experience in electronics retail, luxury retail, or multi-store formats preferred

- Prior experience managing multi-region, large-scale retail operations

- Strong executive presence and stakeholder management ability

- Deep understanding of regional retail dynamics and consumer behavior

- Strong P&L ownership, operational, and inventory management expertise

- Comfortable in high-growth, performance-driven environments

- Agile, dynamic, and capable of scaling with business growth

Location: Gujarat; open to Mumbai, Pune, or Delhi for the right candidate
